name: BeYourCover Partner API
description: Enterprise/partner REST API for AI-powered book cover generation. All endpoints require a partner API key (`Authorization: Bearer byc_sk_...`). Long-running operations (generation, variations, edits, upscales, audiobook covers) return `202 Accepted` with a job envelope; poll `GET /api/v1/jobs/{jobId}` or receive a webhook. All error responses use a uniform envelope: `{ "error": { "code": string, "message": string } }`.
